verdicts.rationale: Commit ebe49dee50 rotated the active JWT key to kid-2026-08 and dropped the previous key (kid-2026-02) from config/auth/jwks.json and services/auth/keys.py. Dropping the old key invalidates all active sessions/tokens issued prior to rotation, directly causing POST /api/auth/verify to return 401 for 92% of requests across callers.

Commit 11788010d3 modifies cache warmup logic in services/auth/cache.py and was committed 4 hours prior to the incident. There is no evidence connecting cache warmup retries to 401 token validation failures.
